column1: # Everyday Ukrainian for the glide list: words a person types in a message that the
# news-and-encyclopedia corpus under-rates or lacks. Merged into uk.txt by
# A boost only raises or adds; tiers: 200 greetings and replies, 180 pronouns, messaging
# verbs and time words, 165 everyday nouns and adjectives. Lowercase letters (with an apostrophe inside a word that has one) only, no names.
# words with an apostrophe: the source rates nearly all of them 10, so the everyday ones are
# set here; every other apostrophe word is known at 70 through uk-apostrophe.tsv
